title: 定义 1.4

source.quote: Deﬁnition 1.4. The homotopy pushout of a diagram X ←Y →Z in Top is

hypotheses: $\Top$ 中的图表 $X\leftarrow Y\rightarrow Z$ 或 $X\rightarrow Y\leftarrow Z$
conclusion: 同伦推出为 $X\sqcup^{h}_{Y}Z\coloneqq X\sqcup_{Y\times\{0\}}(Y\times[0,1])\sqcup_{Y\times\{1\}}Z$；同伦拉回为 $X\times^{h}_{Y}Z\coloneqq X\times^{\{0\}}_{Y}(Y^{[0,1]})\times^{\{1\}}_{Y}Z$
label: L2-1.4
